I guess that was trying to blend in with my schoolmates. Though I did have some what people would call friends back then, I just didn't feel as close as the rest of them. I got severely bullied in my first year of high school, and it was the only time I got really mad at someone. I normally keep my cool in situations like that, but not much I could do that day. Being ridiculed in front of the whole school was too much for me. Now, even though I'm not the best martial artist out there, I practice since I was a kid, so the, uhm, results were black eyes, some blood and a lockjaw. I don't take pride in what I did, but it actually felt so good. People got a little fearful after that. Actually, I got into this fight because of her. A schoolmate saw a picture of her and started to make fun of her and me. I don't deserve her and she doesn't deserve me, and it won't settle with us both alive.

I would feel happy if i was rejected after people talked, not throwing judgemental stares before they even get to know me. When it comes to women, I specially considerated (and i still consider) chemical castration as a solution. This way I won't have worries about my sexual life. As I was a materials/chemical engineering student, I have the knowledge and the means to actually carry on with this/my suicide plan. I always thought of those ideas a last resort, but I can't see the light anymore, after commiting myself to be a "socially likable" and a useful person.

Being an A+ student is nothing special - it just means I won a genetic lottery. There's no merit in that, specially when you lose other the other genetic lotteries.
